title: Solve simultaneous covariance capacity only for a supplied actual catalogue
statement: For actual field moments, W=[[H,B],[B^T,D(w)]], with only Lambda=D-B^T H^+B varying under covariance exchange. Set a=2f-v^T H^+v and r=cvec-B^T H^+v. The nine-by-nine PSD condition [[a-2gamma<|G|^4>,r^T],[r,Lambda(w)]] characterizes the desired gap for the fixed field and catalogue, including range conditions. Canonical backgrounds minimize ell^T W^+ell/2 and the simultaneous cost Gram in Loewner order. The rational implementation solves fixed-weight range systems and returns catalogue annihilators. Variable-weight feasibility is a criterion, not an acquired universal optimizer or a global QC decision.
